questions.prompt: Why must .gitattributes be committed before tagging?
options: git archive reads attributes from the tree being archived, not from the working tree
Tags refuse to be created while there are uncommitted changes
export-ignore only works on files that have been committed at least twice
It does not; archive always reads the working tree's .gitattributes

goals.label: export-ignore for tests/ and notes/ is in the tagged commit
app-2.0.tar.gz has the prefix, the sources, and no tests/ or notes/

check.script: f=app-2.0.tar.gz; [ -f "$f" ] || f="$LESSON_ROOT/app-2.0.tar.gz"; [ -f "$f" ] && l=$(tar tzf "$f") && echo "$l" | grep -q '^app-2.0/src/app.js$' && echo "$l" | grep -q '^app-2.0/README.md$' && ! echo "$l" | grep -q '/tests/.' && ! echo "$l" | grep -q '/notes/.'

goals.label: Say why the attributes must be committed
